messages:
Alex M: taking nightwatch handoff — heads up, ongoing alert for embeddings in eu-west. I'm primary for the next 8h, Priya is secondary. Current summary below.

Alex M: summary: p99 embeddings latency jumped from ~120ms to ~2.3s around 23:12 UTC, error rate up slightly (5xx ~0.6%). Traffic still flowing but a subset of customers see timeouts.

Alex M: customers impacted (observed in logs/dash): AcmeCRM (high qps), Docsify (sporadic timeouts), internal-dev (canary).

Alex M: immediate mitigations in progress: 
- scaled embeddings-repl eu-west from 6 -> 10 pods (awaiting warmup)
- enabled fallback routing to small-embedding-v2 for non-strict requests (traffic-shifted ~18% so far)
- disabled prefetcher on primaries for eu-west to reduce KV pressure

Priya K: noted. do we have any KV store evictions shown?

Sam T: yes, saw increased memstore evicts on kv-node-3 around the spike. Logs: 
```
2026-03-15T23:11:58Z kv-node-3 eviction: prefix_cache size 98% -> evicting
2026-03-15T23:12:03Z kv-node-3 write-heartbeat delayed 352ms
```

Alex M: thanks Sam. I kicked off a node-restart on kv-node-3 (rolling restart) to clear pathological state — watch for transient request retries.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: embeddings-euw-p99-high (severity: P2) — PagerDuty notified, runbook: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/embeddings-p99

PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty alert assigned to Priya K (primary escalation).

Priya K: acked. I'll pick up paging if it escalates. Plan: 1) confirm scale-up effective, 2) monitor evictions and if they persist, spin up extra kv-standby, 3) coordinate with infra for IO/instance metrics.

Jules: quick note — console shows a recent config push at 22:55 that changed prefetch config: `prefetch.max_items=5000 -> 15000`. Could be correlated. I rolled that back in staging earlier.

Alex M: good catch. I just reverted that flag for eu-west (rollback pushed at 23:28). Monitoring for effect.

Priya K: observed latency p95 dropping slightly after scale increment, p99 still heavy. If p99 not improving in next 20m, we plan traffic shed for top noisy customers (non-critical) — will post list before doing it.

Sam T: working on a query to identify noisy customer keys:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as qps, p99(latency)
FROM embeddings.requests
WHERE region='eu-west' AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY qps DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Alex M: note for handoff: open alerts/graphs to monitor —
- Metrics dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/embeddings-eu-west
- Logs explore: https://console.redwood/logs?q=service:embeddings region:eu-west
- Runbook: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/embeddings-p99

Priya K: patch actions in progress list: 
- scaling: done -> verify pods show healthy readiness
- kv restart: in progress on node-3 (Sam)
- rollback prefetch flag: done at 23:28 (Alex)
- routing shift to small-embedding-v2: 18% traffic, can raise to 40% if needed

Sam T: kv-node-3 restart completed at 23:34, monitoring metrics for drop in evictions.

Alex M: customer comms: no public outage yet, but Docsify support pinged us. If we escalate to rate-limiting or shedding, we'll notify affected customers via status.redwood.io.

Priya K: please keep recording noisy customer ids in this thread so we can have an explicit list before shedding.

Alex M: handoff checklist for next oncall: 
- verify p99 trending down for 30m after fixes
- confirm no new 5xx spikes when kv restarts finish
- if shedding required, follow runbook section 'traffic_shedding' and post list in thread
- ensure pager escalation set to on-call team if P1 triggers

Jules: added a watch on infra IO metrics and will alert here if io credit/burst exhausted.

Priya K: I'm taking primary on paging until 03:00 UTC unless I pass back. Alex will remain primary contact for rollout decisions.

Alex M: handing over now — Priya take it from here. leaving my ops notes pinned in the runbook page. :pray:

Priya K: taking handoff, ack. I will post status updates every 15 minutes and on any escalation.

(End of thread)
